BiblicalUsage: Merad is rebellion, the Aramaic word for rising against a king. Ezra 4:19 records the search of the records: this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the charge was true of Jerusalem's past and false as a reason to stop the rebuilding, and that is how old sins get used as new weapons.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
